states.description: Carbon fibre texture is loaded as a valid Three.js texture with non-zero dimensions

states.name: after_check_3
states.description: Rotating pedestal is animating — the BoomBox parent group has a changing Y rotation over time

states.name: after_check_4
states.description: At least one mesh region can be selected via raycasting — a mesh has an outline, emissive highlight, or selection flag after click

states.name: after_check_5
states.description: Roughness slider or parameter adjusts the material roughness to a value between 0.05 and 0.4 for carbon fibre appearance

states.name: after_check_6
states.description: Metalness parameter is set to a high value (>=0.7) consistent with carbon fibre metallic sheen on at least one mesh

states.name: after_check_7
states.description: A normal map is applied to at least one mesh to give the carbon fibre weave pattern depth

states.name: after_check_8
states.description: HUD panel DOM element exists and displays target parameter values for roughness, metalness, and normal intensity

states.name: after_check_9
states.description: Final material parameters match the HUD target values within a tolerance of 0.05, indicating successful validation

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["boom","multi","asset","graphics"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()
